# Kohl's Admin

> Embrace creativity, not chaos.

This file indexes the project for coding agents reading a local copy of it, in the llms.txt format: its guides, then every module, type, and member its Luau source exposes. Links are relative to this file, and each API entry links the lines that declare it, directly below its doc comment.

Keep it current: after changing the public surface, a doc comment, or a guide, run `npx luaudocs@latest llms` in this directory and commit the result. When nothing listed here changed, the command leaves the file as it is.

## Guides

- [Overview](.luaudocs/index.md): Administration, moderation, and command suite for Roblox.
- [Introduction](.luaudocs/guide/intro.md): **Kohl's Admin (KA)** is an administration, moderation, and command suite for Roblox built on [`Flux`](/api/Flux) and [`Z`](/api/Z).
- [Installation](.luaudocs/guide/getting-started/installation.md): Before using Kohl's Admin, install it in your Roblox experience using the **Official Creator Store Loader Model**, a standalone **GitHub Release (`.rbxm`)**, or **Wally & Rojo**.
- [Configuration](.luaudocs/guide/getting-started/configuration.md): All configuration for Kohl's Admin lives inside **`Kohl's Admin > Config > Settings`** in the Roblox Studio Explorer.
- [Using Commands](.luaudocs/guide/getting-started/using_commands.md): Kohl's Admin supports running commands through the **Command Bar** (on PC, Mobile, Console, and VR) as well as through **Roblox Chat** (including native `/` slash commands).
- [Using UIs](.luaudocs/guide/getting-started/using_uis.md): Kohl's Admin includes a reactive user interface built with [`Flux`](/api/Flux) that adapts to PC, Mobile, Tablet, Console, and VR screens.
- [Legacy Loader & Migration](.luaudocs/guide/getting-started/legacy_loader.md): Kohl's Admin includes built-in support for experiences upgrading from **Kohl's Admin Infinite (KAI)**, both through **automatic migration** into the modern loader and an optional **Legacy Loader** mode.
- [Custom Commands](.luaudocs/guide/custom_commands.md): Custom commands let you extend Kohl's Admin with experience-specific tools, automate developer workflows, and create interactive player commands with full autocomplete and permission checks.
- [Addons & Hooks](.luaudocs/guide/addons.md): Addons are the primary way to extend Kohl's Admin with custom logic, server integrations, event listeners, custom commands, custom argument types, and custom UI windows.
- [Custom Argument Types](.luaudocs/guide/custom_types.md): When the [built-in argument types](/guide/custom_commands#built-in-argument-types) and inline enums aren't enough, you can register custom argument types with [`_K.Registry.registerType`](/api/Registry#registertype).
- [Themes & Custom UI](.luaudocs/guide/themes_and_ui.md): Kohl's Admin features a reactive UI framework powered by [`Flux`](/api/Flux) and [`_K.UI`](/api/UI).
- [Troubleshooting](.luaudocs/guide/troubleshooting.md): This guide covers solutions to the most common setup, permission, DataStore, and customization issues in Kohl's Admin.
- [Support](.luaudocs/guide/support.md): If you need help with Kohl's Admin (KA), have a question about custom addons, or want to report a bug, several community and documentation resources are available.

- [`Auth.prefetchGroupEntryRanks()`](src/Shared/Auth.luau#L885-L892): Starts fetching the entry rank of every group in the group roles, so role checks don't stay closed on first use

## MainModule.Chat

- [Chat](src/Shared/Chat.luau): Delivers admin messages (hints, messages, notifications, private messages, votes, text to speech and announcements) to the admin UI of each recipient, as text the server filtered for broadcast.
- [`Chat.COOLDOWN: number`](src/Shared/Chat.luau#L25)
- [`Chat.cooldown(userId: number, key: string, seconds: number?): string?`](src/Shared/Chat.luau#L31-L46): Rate limits user-editable text shown to other users, returns a message while cooling down
- [`Chat.commandPrefixes(prefixes: { string }?): { string }`](src/Shared/Chat.luau#L49-L62): Lists the prefixes that can start a chat command alias: single characters that aren't letters, digits or spaces
- [`Chat.canUserChat(userId: number): boolean`](src/Shared/Chat.luau#L72): [Yields]
- [`Chat.canUsersChat(fromUserId: number, toUserId: number): boolean`](src/Shared/Chat.luau#L82): [Yields]
- [`Chat.hasRestrictedPeer(fromUserId: number, players: { Player }?): boolean`](src/Shared/Chat.luau#L85-L95): [Yields] Returns true when any player in `players` (or the server) cannot chat with `fromUserId`
- [`Chat.limitBroadcast(userId: number, _roleError: string?): string?`](src/Shared/Chat.luau#L98-L103): [Yields] Gates user text shown to everyone behind a chat check and the shared announcement cooldown
- [`Chat.restoreRichText(text: string, compact: boolean?): string`](src/Shared/Chat.luau#L177-L203): Restores a safe subset of rich text in text that TextChatService filtered and escaped: b, i, u, s, sc, uc, br, and font with color, transparency and a clamped size.
- [`Chat.send(context: any, kind: string, text: string, targets: { Player }?, data: any?): (string?, string?, { Player }?)`](src/Shared/Chat.luau#L218-L291): [Yields] Sends a message of `kind` to everyone in the server, or only to `targets`, through Remote.ChatSystem to the admin UI.
- [`Chat.limitReason(userId: number, reason: string?, players: { Player }?): (string?, string?)`](src/Shared/Chat.luau#L298-L318): [Yields] Filters and rate limits a free-text reason (ban, kick, shutdown) that other users see.
- [`Chat.onMessage(kind: string, callback: (text: string, from: number, data: any, id: string) -> ())`](src/Shared/Chat.luau#L325-L327): Registers the client handler for a message kind, called with the filtered text, sender UserId, data and id
- [`Chat.pinAnnouncement(announcement: any): boolean`](src/Shared/Chat.luau#L339-L359): Tracks the pinned announcement ({ text, from, duration, id }) shown on this client.
- [`Chat.waitForMessage(id: string, timeout: number?): string?`](src/Shared/Chat.luau#L362-L384): [Yields] Waits for the filtered text of a message by id, or nil when it doesn't arrive in time

## MainModule.Flux

- [Flux](vendor/flux/src/init.luau): Reactive UI library for Roblox and Luau, including fine-grained signals, declarative instances, layout, motion, `Flux.Clock`, and `Flux.Sync`.

- [`Flux.Color: Color`](vendor/flux/src/Motion.luau#L1120): [from Motion] Perceptual [`Color3`](https://create.roblox.com/docs/reference/engine/datatypes/Color3) utilities in Oklab (`lighten`, `saturate`, `mix`, `rotateHue`, and WCAG `contrast`/`readable`).
- [`Flux.Defaults: { [string]: { [string]: unknown } }`](vendor/flux/src/Edit.luau#L1066): [Read Only] [from Edit] Mutable table of per-class default properties applied by [`Flux.new`](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/roblox/creation#the-flux-new-function).
- [`Flux.Find: Find`](vendor/flux/src/Edit.luau#L1067): [from Edit] Instance selectors (`Child`, `Descendant`, `Ancestor`, `Path`, `Query`) for hydrating trees inside [`Flux.edit`](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/roblox/hydration).
- [`Flux.Flags: Flags`](vendor/flux/src/Edit.luau#L1065): [from Edit] Global behavior flags (`Flags.defaults` toggles per-class defaults in [`Flux.new`](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/roblox/creation#the-flux-new-function)).
- [`Flux.Sync: Sync`](vendor/flux/src/Sync.luau): [Module] Network-synchronized signals replicated from the server to clients once per frame.
- [`Flux.otherwise: any`](vendor/flux/src/Conditional.luau#L571): [Read Only] [from Conditional] Catch-all branch key for [`Flux.switch`](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/concepts/conditionals#a-catch-all-branch) maps when `source` matches no explicit key.
- [`Flux.edit<T>(instance: T & Instance)`](vendor/flux/src/init.luau#L290-L294): Applies reactive properties, events, children, and directives to an existing [`Instance`](https://create.roblox.com/docs/reference/engine/classes/Instance).
- [`Flux.new<T>(className: T | keyof<Type.Creatable>)`](vendor/flux/src/init.luau#L312-L314): Creates a Roblox [`Instance`](https://create.roblox.com/docs/reference/engine/classes/Instance) of `className` with its per-class [defaults](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/roblox/defaults) and applies a table of properties, events, children, and directives.
- [`Flux.signal(initial: any, equals: any): any`](vendor/flux/src/Graph.luau#L3019): [from Graph] Creates a writable [signal](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/concepts/signals) holding `initial`, using `equals` (default `==`) to skip unchanged writes.
- [`Flux.computed(fn: any, equals: any): any`](vendor/flux/src/Graph.luau#L3032): [from Graph] Creates a lazily cached [computed](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/concepts/computeds) node derived from `fn`.
- [`Flux.effect(fn: (...any) -> ...any): any`](vendor/flux/src/Graph.luau#L3043): [from Graph] Schedules `fn` to run on the next flush and re-run whenever any node it reads changes.
- [`Flux.createSignal<T>(initial: T, equals: ((T, T: any) -> boolean)?): (() -> T, (value: T, force: boolean?) -> T)`](vendor/flux/src/Graph.luau#L3072): [from Graph] Creates a lightweight signal without a node wrapper and returns `(getter, setter)`.
- [`Flux.createMemo<T>(fn: () -> T, equals: ((T, T) -> boolean)?): () -> T`](vendor/flux/src/Graph.luau#L3084): [from Graph] Creates a lightweight computed without a node wrapper and returns its tracked getter function.
- [`Flux.createEffect(fn: (...any) -> ...any)`](vendor/flux/src/Graph.luau#L3095): [from Graph] Creates a lightweight effect without returning a node wrapper.
- [`Flux.getter(node: any): any`](vendor/flux/src/Graph.luau#L3055): [from Graph] Returns a plain function that reads `node` with tracking, avoiding wrapper `__call` overhead in hot loops.
- [`Flux.setter(node: any): any`](vendor/flux/src/Graph.luau#L3059): [from Graph] Returns a plain function that writes `node` (`setter(value, force)`), avoiding wrapper `__call` overhead in hot loops.
- [`Flux.scope<T>(fn: (scope: Node<any>) -> T): (Node<any>, T)`](vendor/flux/src/Graph.luau#L3114): [from Graph] Runs `fn` in a new owner [scope](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/concepts/scopes) and returns `(scope, result)`.
- [`Flux.flush()`](vendor/flux/src/Graph.luau#L3101): [from Graph] Runs all queued [effects](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/concepts/effects) immediately instead of waiting for the next frame.
- [`Flux.cleanup(obj: Cleanable)`](vendor/flux/src/Graph.luau#L3128): [from Graph] Registers `obj` to be disposed via [`Flux.dispose`](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/concepts/scopes#disposing-by-hand-with-flux-dispose) before the running reaction re-runs and when its owner is destroyed.
- [`Flux.dispose(obj: Cleanable?)`](vendor/flux/src/Graph.luau#L3140): [from Graph] Tears down `obj` immediately (functions, instances, connections, threads, objects with `Destroy`/`Disconnect` methods, or arrays of cleanables).
- [`Flux.getOwner(): Owner?`](vendor/flux/src/Graph.luau#L3147): [from Graph] Returns the active reactive owner, or `nil` at the root.
- [`Flux.withOwner(node: any, fn: () -> ...any): ...any`](vendor/flux/src/Graph.luau#L3155): [from Graph] Runs `fn` with `owner` (from `Flux.getOwner`, a node, or `nil` for unowned roots) as the active owner and restores its captured [context](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/concepts/context#deferred-code).
- [`Flux.read(object: any): any`](vendor/flux/src/Graph.luau#L3199): [from Graph] Reads a `Reactive` value (node, getter function, or plain value) and subscribes the running reaction if it's dynamic.
- [`Flux.raw(object: any): any`](vendor/flux/src/Graph.luau#L3187): [from Graph] Reads a `Reactive` value (node, getter function, or plain value) without subscribing the running reaction.
- [`Flux.untrack(fn: (() -> ...any)?): ...any`](vendor/flux/src/Graph.luau#L3169): [from Graph] Runs `fn` without dependency [tracking](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/concepts/tracking) and returns its result.
- [`Flux.retrack()`](vendor/flux/src/Graph.luau#L3181): [from Graph] Resumes [tracking](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/concepts/tracking) after a bare `Flux.untrack()` in the same function body.
- [`Flux.isNode(object: any): boolean`](vendor/flux/src/Graph.luau#L3238): [from Graph] Returns `true` if `object` is a Flux [node](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/concepts/signals).
- [`Flux.isReactive(): boolean`](vendor/flux/src/Graph.luau#L3246): [from Graph] Returns `true` if called inside a tracking [computed](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/concepts/computeds) or [effect](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/concepts/effects).
- [`Flux.on<D, R>(deps: any, fn: (input: any, prevInput: any?, prevResult: R?) -> R, defer: boolean?): (prevResult: R?) -> R?`](vendor/flux/src/Bind.luau#L566-L604): [from Bind] Wraps `fn` so a [computed](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/concepts/computeds) or [effect](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/concepts/effects) tracks only `deps` and runs `fn(input, prevInput, prevResult)` untracked.
- [`Flux.context(default: any): any`](vendor/flux/src/Graph.luau#L3219): [from Graph] Creates a [context](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/concepts/context) with the given `default` value for passing data down a component tree without prop drilling.
- [`Flux.bindContext<A..., R...>(fn: (A...) -> R...): (A...) -> R...`](vendor/flux/src/Graph.luau#L3232): [from Graph] Wraps `fn` so every call sees the [context](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/concepts/context#deferred-code) values active when `bindContext` was called.
- [`Flux.async(source: any, fetcher: any, initialValue: any): Async<any>`](vendor/flux/src/Async.luau#L211-L215): [from Async] Runs yielding work off the reactive graph and exposes its progress as `.data`, `.error`, `.loading`, and `.state` nodes.
- [`Flux.selector<S, K>(source: S, equals: ((sourceValue: Graph.Unwrap<S>, key: K) -> boolean)?): Selector<K>`](vendor/flux/src/Conditional.luau#L599): [from Conditional] Creates a keyed selector that tracks which key matches `source` in O(1) (or O(observed keys) with a custom `equals` comparator).
- [`Flux.store<T>(initialState: T): T`](vendor/flux/src/Store.luau#L250-L257): [from Store] Wraps a plain table in a deep reactive proxy that tracks each read key, nested table, and array length independently.
- [`Flux.split(props: any, keys: any, ...: any): ...any`](vendor/flux/src/Edit.luau#L1080): [from Edit] Partitions `props` into one table per `keys` group plus a final table holding every remaining key, leaving `props` untouched.
- [`Flux.safe<T>(tryFn: () -> T, fallback: T | (err: unknown) -> T, equals: ((a: T, b: T) -> boolean)?): Node<T>`](vendor/flux/src/Graph.luau#L3207): [from Graph] Creates a [computed](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/concepts/computeds) that evaluates `tryFn` and returns `fallback` (a static value or an untracked `(err) -> T` function) if `tryFn` throws.
- [`Flux.property<I, K>(instance: I & Instance, property: K | "Name"): Graph.Node<Type.PropertyType<I, K>>`](vendor/flux/src/Bind.luau#L533-L540): [from Bind] Creates a [node](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/concepts/signals) mirroring an [`Instance`](https://create.roblox.com/docs/reference/engine/classes/Instance) property, an attribute (`$Name` or `_attr_Name`), or a [`CollectionService`](https://create.roblox.com/docs/reference/engine/classes/CollectionService) tag (`#Tag` or `_tag_Tag`).
- [`Flux.model<N>(node: N): Graph.Unwrap<N>`](vendor/flux/src/Bind.luau#L401-L407): [from Bind] Wraps a reactive [node](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/concepts/signals) for two-way binding on an [`Instance`](https://create.roblox.com/docs/reference/engine/classes/Instance) property, attribute, or tag.
- [`Flux.isModel(value: unknown): boolean`](vendor/flux/src/Bind.luau#L414-L417): [from Bind] Returns `true` when `value` is a [`Flux.model`](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/roblox/creation#flux-model-two-way-binding-in-one-key) wrapper.
- [`Flux.modelNode(value: unknown): Graph.Node<any>?`](vendor/flux/src/Bind.luau#L431-L434): [from Bind] Returns the underlying node from a [`Flux.model`](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/roblox/creation#flux-model-two-way-binding-in-one-key) wrapper, or `nil` if `value` is not a model.
- [`Flux.show<T, F>(condition: unknown, component: (value: () -> any) -> T, fallback: ((value: () -> any) -> F)?): Node<T | F>`](vendor/flux/src/Conditional.luau#L578-L582): [from Conditional] Mounts `component` while `condition` is truthy, or `fallback` when falsy, in its own child [scope](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/concepts/scopes).
- [`Flux.showKeyed<T, F>(condition: unknown, component: (value: () -> any) -> T, fallback: ((value: () -> any) -> F)?): Node<T | F>`](vendor/flux/src/Conditional.luau#L588-L592): [from Conditional] Mounts `component` while `condition` is truthy (or `fallback` when falsy) and remounts in a fresh [scope](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/concepts/scopes) whenever `condition` changes identity.
- [`Flux.switch<S>(source: S)`](vendor/flux/src/Conditional.luau#L593): [from Conditional] Mounts the branch factory matching `source`'s current value in its own child [scope](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/concepts/scopes).
- [`Flux.presence<T>(condition: unknown, component: (exiting: Node<boolean>, done: () -> ()) -> T): Node<T?>`](vendor/flux/src/Conditional.luau#L594): [from Conditional] Mounts `component(exiting, done)` while `condition` is truthy and keeps it mounted while `exiting()` is `true` until `done()` is called.
- [`Flux.pick(condition: unknown, whenTrue: any, whenFalse: any?): Node<any>`](vendor/flux/src/Conditional.luau#L595): [from Conditional] Derives a [node](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/concepts/signals) returning `whenTrue` while `condition` is truthy and `whenFalse` otherwise.
- [`Flux.fallback<V, D>(value: V, default: D): Node<NonNil<Graph.Unwrap<V>> | Graph.Unwrap<D>>`](vendor/flux/src/Conditional.luau#L596): [from Conditional] Derives a [node](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/concepts/signals) returning `value` when non-`nil`, or `default` when `value` is `nil`.
- [`Flux.forValue<L, U>(list: L, mapFn: (index: Node<number>, value: Item<L>) -> U): Node<{ U }>`](vendor/flux/src/Conditional.luau#L598): [from Conditional] Maps `list` by item identity, running `mapFn(index, value)` once per unique value and updating `index` when an item moves.
- [`Flux.forIndex<L, U>(list: L, mapFn: (index: number, item: Node<Item<L>>) -> U): Node<{ U }>`](vendor/flux/src/Conditional.luau#L597): [from Conditional] Maps `list` by numeric index, running `mapFn(index, item)` once per slot and updating `item` in place when the value at that index changes.
- [`Flux.spring<A>(target: A, frequency: Reactive<number>?, damping: Reactive<number>?, initialVelocity: any?): Spring<Unwrap<A>>`](vendor/flux/src/Motion.luau#L1148-L1194): [from Motion] Creates a [node](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/concepts/signals) that animates toward `target` using an analytic harmonic oscillator (`frequency` in Hz and `damping` ratio both default to `1` and may be reactive).
- [`Flux.tween<A>(target: A, tweenInfo: Reactive<TweenInfo>?): Graph.Node<Unwrap<A>>`](vendor/flux/src/Motion.luau#L1203-L1243): [from Motion] Creates a [node](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/concepts/signals) that eases toward `target` over a [`TweenInfo`](https://create.roblox.com/docs/reference/engine/datatypes/TweenInfo) curve.
- [`Flux.padding(value: Length | PaddingSides | Graph.Node<any> | (() -> Length | Insets)): UIPadding`](vendor/flux/src/Layout.luau#L393-L418): [from Layout] Creates a [`UIPadding`](https://create.roblox.com/docs/reference/engine/classes/UIPadding) from a single length, a `{ top, bottom, left, right, x, y }` table, or a reactive source.
- [`Flux.corner(radius: ReactiveLength | CornerSides?): UICorner`](vendor/flux/src/Layout.luau#L425-L437): [from Layout] Creates a [`UICorner`](https://create.roblox.com/docs/reference/engine/classes/UICorner) from an offset pixel radius, a [`UDim`](https://create.roblox.com/docs/reference/engine/datatypes/UDim), or a per-corner `{ topLeft, topRight, bottomLeft, bottomRight, top, bottom, left, right, radius }` table.
- [`Flux.stroke(config: StrokeConfig?): UIStroke`](vendor/flux/src/Layout.luau#L444-L457): [from Layout] Creates a [`UIStroke`](https://create.roblox.com/docs/reference/engine/classes/UIStroke) with static or reactive `thickness`, `color`, `transparency`, `mode`, `joins`, `position`, and `offset`.
- [`Flux.aspectRatio(ratio: Reactive<number>, aspectType: Reactive<"fit" | "scale" | Enum.AspectType>?, dominantAxis: Reactive<"width" | "height" | Enum.DominantAxis>?): UIAspectRatioConstraint`](vendor/flux/src/Layout.luau#L464-L474): [from Layout] Creates a [`UIAspectRatioConstraint`](https://create.roblox.com/docs/reference/engine/classes/UIAspectRatioConstraint) with `ratio`, `aspectType` (`"fit"` or `"scale"`), and `dominantAxis` (`"width"` or `"height"`).
- [`Flux.list(config: ListConfig?): UIListLayout`](vendor/flux/src/Layout.luau#L481-L507): [from Layout] Creates a [`UIListLayout`](https://create.roblox.com/docs/reference/engine/classes/UIListLayout) with `SortOrder = LayoutOrder` and flexbox-style `gap`, `direction`, `align` (cross-axis), `justify` (main-axis), and `wraps` options.
- [`Flux.grid(config: GridConfig?): UIGridLayout`](vendor/flux/src/Layout.luau#L514-L525): [from Layout] Creates a [`UIGridLayout`](https://create.roblox.com/docs/reference/engine/classes/UIGridLayout) with `SortOrder = LayoutOrder` and `cell`, `gap`, `fill`, `align`, `justify`, and `maxCells` options.
- [`Flux.flex(mode: Reactive<FlexMode | Enum.UIFlexMode>?): UIFlexItem`](vendor/flux/src/Layout.luau#L532-L546): [from Layout] Creates a [`UIFlexItem`](https://create.roblox.com/docs/reference/engine/classes/UIFlexItem) with `mode` (`"fill"` by default, `"grow"`, `"shrink"`, or `"none"`).
- [`Flux.gradient(config: GradientConfig?): UIGradient`](vendor/flux/src/Layout.luau#L553-L562): [from Layout] Creates a [`UIGradient`](https://create.roblox.com/docs/reference/engine/classes/UIGradient) from single values, evenly spaced stop arrays, or sequences for `color` and `transparency`.
- [`Flux.sizeConstraint(config: SizeConstraintConfig?): UISizeConstraint`](vendor/flux/src/Layout.luau#L569-L575): [from Layout] Creates a [`UISizeConstraint`](https://create.roblox.com/docs/reference/engine/classes/UISizeConstraint) from `min`/`max` `Vector2` bounds or per-axis `minWidth`, `minHeight`, `maxWidth`, and `maxHeight` bounds.
- [`Flux.textSizeConstraint(config: TextSizeConstraintConfig?): UITextSizeConstraint`](vendor/flux/src/Layout.luau#L582-L588): [from Layout] Creates a [`UITextSizeConstraint`](https://create.roblox.com/docs/reference/engine/classes/UITextSizeConstraint) bounding text size between `min` and `max` pixels.
- [`Flux.__call(_: any, obj: any, propertyName: string?): Graph.Node<any>`](vendor/flux/src/init.luau#L274-L277): Terse untyped constructor for a [signal](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/concepts/signals) (`Flux(value)`), [computed](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/concepts/computeds) (`Flux(fn)`), or [instance property node](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/concepts/signals#binding-from-an-instance-property) (`Flux(instance, key)`).
- [`Flux.Clock`](vendor/flux/src/init.luau#L100-L113): Shared time source for timers, frame callbacks, and deterministic test stepping.
- [`Flux.Clock.now(): number`](vendor/flux/src/Clock.luau#L168-L170): [from Clock] Seconds on a monotonic clock, for measuring intervals: `os.clock()` in a game, virtual time on a manual clock.
- [`Flux.Clock.wall(): number`](vendor/flux/src/Clock.luau#L176-L181): [from Clock] Unix time in seconds, for dates and countdowns shared between players: `workspace:GetServerTimeNow()` in a game, `2026-01-01T00:00:00Z + now()` on a manual clock.
- [`Flux.Clock.delay<A...>(seconds: number?, fn: ((A...) -> ...any) | thread, ...: A...): thread`](vendor/flux/src/Clock.luau#L194-L201): [from Clock] Runs `fn(...)` (or resumes a thread) after `seconds`, like `task.delay`.
- [`Flux.Clock.wait(seconds: number?): number`](vendor/flux/src/Clock.luau#L207-L217): [Yields] [from Clock] Yields the running thread for `seconds` (default: one frame), like `task.wait`, and returns the time it waited.
- [`Flux.Clock.defer<A...>(fn: ((A...) -> ...any) | thread, ...: A...): thread`](vendor/flux/src/Clock.luau#L223-L233): [from Clock] Runs `fn(...)` (or resumes a thread) once the current work finishes, like `task.defer`.
- [`Flux.Clock.cancel(thread: thread)`](vendor/flux/src/Clock.luau#L238-L260): [from Clock] Cancels a thread from `delay`, `defer` or a `wait`, like `task.cancel`.
- [`Flux.Clock.connect(phase: Phase, fn: (dt: number) -> ()): () -> ()`](vendor/flux/src/Clock.luau#L266-L287): [from Clock] Calls `fn(dt)` every frame at `phase` ("PreRender", "RenderStepped" or "Heartbeat").
- [`Flux.Clock.manual(on: boolean)`](vendor/flux/src/Clock.luau#L293-L304): [from Clock] Toggles manual clock mode for tests (headless Luau is always manual).
- [`Flux.Clock.isManual(): boolean`](vendor/flux/src/Clock.luau#L309-L311): [from Clock] Tests only: whether the clock is manual.
- [`Flux.Clock.step(seconds: number, frameLength: number?)`](vendor/flux/src/Clock.luau#L378-L393): [from Clock] Tests only: advances a manual clock by `seconds`, in frames of at most `frameLength` seconds (default 1/60).
- [`Flux.Clock.drain()`](vendor/flux/src/Clock.luau#L317-L338): [from Clock] Tests only: runs deferred work until none is left, including work it defers in turn.
- [`Flux.Clock.reset()`](vendor/flux/src/Clock.luau#L398-L406): [from Clock] Tests only: drops every pending timer, `wait`, deferred call and manual subscriber.
- [`Flux.Interact`](vendor/flux/src/init.luau#L143-L151): Read-only interaction state nodes (`hover`, `press`, `selected`, `focused`) and pointer hit-testing helpers (`pointIn`, `sunk`, `covered`).
- [`Flux.Interact.pointIn(x: number, y: number, object: GuiObject): boolean`](vendor/flux/src/Interact.luau#L681): [from Interact] Whether the point `(x, y)` lies within `object`'s absolute bounds (inclusive, ignoring rotation).
- [`Flux.Interact.sunk(x: number, y: number, object: GuiObject, token: any?): boolean`](vendor/flux/src/Interact.luau#L682): [from Interact] Returns `true` when input at `(x, y)` would be claimed by an `Active` or input-sinking GUI rendered above `object` (or while the Roblox escape menu is open).
- [`Flux.Interact.covered(x: number, y: number, object: GuiObject, token: any?): boolean`](vendor/flux/src/Interact.luau#L683): [from Interact] Returns `true` when input at `(x, y)` would be claimed by an `Active` or input-sinking GUI above `object` that is not a descendant of `object`.
- [`Flux.Interact.hover(object: GuiObject, options: HoverOptions?): Graph.Node<boolean>`](vendor/flux/src/Interact.luau#L685): [from Interact] Returns a read-only boolean [node](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/concepts/signals) that is `true` while a pointer or touch contact is inside `object` with no input-claiming GUI above it.
- [`Flux.Interact.press(object: GuiObject): Graph.Node<boolean>`](vendor/flux/src/Interact.luau#L686): [from Interact] Returns a read-only boolean [node](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/concepts/signals) that is `true` while `object` is held down by pointer, touch, or gamepad/keyboard activation (`ButtonA`/`Enter`).
- [`Flux.Interact.selected(object: GuiObject): Graph.Node<boolean>`](vendor/flux/src/Interact.luau#L687): [from Interact] Returns a read-only boolean [node](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/concepts/signals) tracking whether `object` is currently [`GuiService.SelectedObject`](https://create.roblox.com/docs/reference/engine/classes/GuiService#SelectedObject).
- [`Flux.Interact.focused(textBox: TextBox): Graph.Node<boolean>`](vendor/flux/src/Interact.luau#L688): [from Interact] Returns a read-only boolean [node](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/concepts/signals) tracking whether `textBox` currently has keyboard focus.
- [`Flux.Motion`](vendor/flux/src/init.luau#L158-L160): Advances active [`Flux.spring`](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/motion/spring) and [`Flux.tween`](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/motion/tween) nodes.
- [`Flux.Motion.step(dt: number?)`](vendor/flux/src/Motion.luau#L1134): [from Motion] Advances every active [spring](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/motion/spring) and [tween](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/motion/tween) by `dt` seconds (or the time since the last step).
- [`Flux.Responsive`](vendor/flux/src/init.luau#L166-L179): Reactive nodes for viewport size, UI scale, breakpoints, device platform, active input mode, and accessibility settings.
- [`Flux.Responsive.config: Config`](vendor/flux/src/Responsive.luau#L322): [Read Only] [from Responsive] Default responsive configuration shared by derived nodes.
- [`Flux.Responsive.platform: Graph.Node<Platform>`](vendor/flux/src/Responsive.luau#L323): [Read Only] [from Responsive] Active device class (`"vr"`, `"console"`, `"pc"`, or `"mobile"`), updated live on the client (`"pc"` off-client).
- [`Flux.Responsive.viewport: Graph.Node<Vector2>`](vendor/flux/src/Responsive.luau#L325): [Read Only] [from Responsive] The active camera's `ViewportSize` as a node, live on the client.
- [`Flux.Responsive.scale: Graph.Node<number>`](vendor/flux/src/Responsive.luau#L326): [Read Only] [from Responsive] UI scale factor derived from `viewport` (`1.0` at `config.reference`).
- [`Flux.Responsive.breakpoint: Graph.Node<Breakpoint>`](vendor/flux/src/Responsive.luau#L327): [Read Only] [from Responsive] Size class (`"phone" | "tablet" | "desktop"`) derived from `viewport` width.
- [`Flux.Responsive.displaySize: Graph.Node<DisplaySize>`](vendor/flux/src/Responsive.luau#L328): [Read Only] [from Responsive] Physical screen size class (`"Small"`, `"Medium"`, or `"Large"`) mirroring `GuiService.ViewportDisplaySize`.
- [`Flux.Responsive.input: Graph.Node<Input>`](vendor/flux/src/Responsive.luau#L330): [Read Only] [from Responsive] Active input mode (`"keyboard"`, `"touch"`, or `"gamepad"`) tracking `UserInputService.PreferredInput` on the client.
- [`Flux.Responsive.textSize: Graph.Node<TextSize>`](vendor/flux/src/Responsive.luau#L331): [Read Only] [from Responsive] Player's preferred text size (`"Medium"`, `"Large"`, `"Larger"`, or `"Largest"`) from `GuiService.PreferredTextSize`.
- [`Flux.Responsive.reducedMotion: Graph.Node<boolean>`](vendor/flux/src/Responsive.luau#L332): [Read Only] [from Responsive] Tracks `GuiService.ReducedMotionEnabled` (`true` when the player prefers reduced motion).
- [`Flux.Responsive.preferredTransparency: Graph.Node<number>`](vendor/flux/src/Responsive.luau#L333): [Read Only] [from Responsive] Tracks `GuiService.PreferredTransparency` from `0` (opaque backgrounds) to `1` (default).
- [`Flux.Responsive.scaleOf(partial: PartialConfig?): Graph.Node<number>`](vendor/flux/src/Responsive.luau#L335): [from Responsive] Factory escape hatch: a `scale` node with per-surface config (merged over defaults).
- [`Flux.Responsive.breakpointOf(partial: PartialConfig?): Graph.Node<Breakpoint>`](vendor/flux/src/Responsive.luau#L336): [from Responsive] Factory escape hatch: a `breakpoint` node with per-surface thresholds.
- [`Flux.Store`](vendor/flux/src/init.luau#L185-L192): Array mutation (`insert`, `remove`, `move`), snapshot diffing (`reconcile`), unwrapping (`unwrap`), and teardown (`Destroy`) for [`Flux.store`](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/concepts/stores) proxies.
- [`Flux.Store.insert(proxy: any, posOrValue: any, value: any?)`](vendor/flux/src/Store.luau#L282-L309): [from Store] Inserts `value` into a store array (appending with 2 arguments, or inserting at `posOrValue` with 3) and notifies length and index observers.
- [`Flux.Store.remove(proxy: any, pos: number?): any`](vendor/flux/src/Store.luau#L316-L344): [from Store] Removes and returns the element at `pos` (defaulting to the last element) from a store array and notifies length and index observers.
- [`Flux.Store.move(proxy: any, from: number, to: number)`](vendor/flux/src/Store.luau#L351-L370): [from Store] Moves the element at 1-based index `from` to `to` in a single tracked step without tearing down nested item proxies.
- [`Flux.Store.reconcile<T>(proxy: T, newData: T, key: string?): T`](vendor/flux/src/Store.luau#L561-L569): [from Store] Diffs `newData` into the store `proxy` in place, firing only changed leaf nodes and reusing unchanged nested proxies.
- [`Flux.Store.unwrap<T>(proxy: T): T`](vendor/flux/src/Store.luau#L273-L275): [from Store] Returns the raw, unproxied backing table of a store for untracked reads or serialization.
- [`Flux.Store.Destroy<T>(proxy: T)`](vendor/flux/src/Store.luau#L264-L266): [from Store] Tears down a store and all of its nested proxies, disposing their per-key nodes via [`Flux.dispose`](https://flux.kohl.gg/api/Flux#dispose) while leaving the raw backing table intact.

## Async

- [Async](vendor/flux/src/Async.luau): Async resources: a fetcher runs off the graph, and its progress is exposed as nodes (`data`, `error`, `loading`, `state`). Constructors: `Async.new`.
- [`type AsyncState = "unresolved" | "pending" | "ready" | "refreshing" | "errored"`](vendor/flux/src/Async.luau#L34): The state of an [async](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/concepts/async) node, derived from its `.error`/`.loading` and whether a fetch has resolved.
- [`type Async<T>`](vendor/flux/src/Async.luau#L37-L61)
- [`Async.new(source: any, fetcher: any, initialValue: any): Async<any>`](vendor/flux/src/Async.luau#L211-L215): Runs yielding work off the reactive graph and exposes its progress as `.data`, `.error`, `.loading`, and `.state` nodes.
- [`Async:Destroy()`](vendor/flux/src/Async.luau#L150-L163): Destroys the async node, cleaning up all resources.
- [`Async:mutate(value: any)`](vendor/flux/src/Async.luau#L170-L180): Optimistically writes `data` and invalidates any in-flight fetch.
- [`Async:refetch(refetching: any?)`](vendor/flux/src/Async.luau#L188-L198): Re-runs the fetcher with the current source value without writing the source node.

## Bind

- [Bind](vendor/flux/src/Bind.luau)
- [`Bind.model<N>(node: N): Graph.Unwrap<N>`](vendor/flux/src/Bind.luau#L401-L407): Wraps a reactive [node](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/concepts/signals) for two-way binding on an [`Instance`](https://create.roblox.com/docs/reference/engine/classes/Instance) property, attribute, or tag.
- [`Bind.isModel(value: unknown): boolean`](vendor/flux/src/Bind.luau#L414-L417): Returns `true` when `value` is a [`Flux.model`](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/roblox/creation#flux-model-two-way-binding-in-one-key) wrapper.
- [`Bind.modelNode(value: unknown): Graph.Node<any>?`](vendor/flux/src/Bind.luau#L431-L434): Returns the underlying node from a [`Flux.model`](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/roblox/creation#flux-model-two-way-binding-in-one-key) wrapper, or `nil` if `value` is not a model.
- [`Bind.property<I, K>(instance: I & Instance, property: K | "Name"): Graph.Node<Type.PropertyType<I, K>>`](vendor/flux/src/Bind.luau#L533-L540): Creates a [node](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/concepts/signals) mirroring an [`Instance`](https://create.roblox.com/docs/reference/engine/classes/Instance) property, an attribute (`$Name` or `_attr_Name`), or a [`CollectionService`](https://create.roblox.com/docs/reference/engine/classes/CollectionService) tag (`#Tag` or `_tag_Tag`).
- [`Bind.on<D, R>(deps: any, fn: (input: any, prevInput: any?, prevResult: R?) -> R, defer: boolean?): (prevResult: R?) -> R?`](vendor/flux/src/Bind.luau#L566-L604): Wraps `fn` so a [computed](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/concepts/computeds) or [effect](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/concepts/effects) tracks only `deps` and runs `fn(input, prevInput, prevResult)` untracked.

## Clock

- [Clock](vendor/flux/src/Clock.luau): Shared clock for timers, frame callbacks, and deterministic stepping in tests.
- [`type Phase = "PreRender" | "RenderStepped" | "Heartbeat"`](vendor/flux/src/Clock.luau#L16)
- [`Clock.now(): number`](vendor/flux/src/Clock.luau#L168-L170): Seconds on a monotonic clock, for measuring intervals: `os.clock()` in a game, virtual time on a manual clock.
- [`Clock.wall(): number`](vendor/flux/src/Clock.luau#L176-L181): Unix time in seconds, for dates and countdowns shared between players: `workspace:GetServerTimeNow()` in a game, `2026-01-01T00:00:00Z + now()` on a manual clock.
- [`Clock.delay<A...>(seconds: number?, fn: ((A...) -> ...any) | thread, ...: A...): thread`](vendor/flux/src/Clock.luau#L194-L201): Runs `fn(...)` (or resumes a thread) after `seconds`, like `task.delay`.
- [`Clock.wait(seconds: number?): number`](vendor/flux/src/Clock.luau#L207-L217): [Yields] Yields the running thread for `seconds` (default: one frame), like `task.wait`, and returns the time it waited.
- [`Clock.defer<A...>(fn: ((A...) -> ...any) | thread, ...: A...): thread`](vendor/flux/src/Clock.luau#L223-L233): Runs `fn(...)` (or resumes a thread) once the current work finishes, like `task.defer`.
- [`Clock.cancel(thread: thread)`](vendor/flux/src/Clock.luau#L238-L260): Cancels a thread from `delay`, `defer` or a `wait`, like `task.cancel`.
- [`Clock.connect(phase: Phase, fn: (dt: number) -> ()): () -> ()`](vendor/flux/src/Clock.luau#L266-L287): Calls `fn(dt)` every frame at `phase` ("PreRender", "RenderStepped" or "Heartbeat").
- [`Clock.manual(on: boolean)`](vendor/flux/src/Clock.luau#L293-L304): Toggles manual clock mode for tests (headless Luau is always manual).
- [`Clock.isManual(): boolean`](vendor/flux/src/Clock.luau#L309-L311): Tests only: whether the clock is manual.
- [`Clock.drain()`](vendor/flux/src/Clock.luau#L317-L338): Tests only: runs deferred work until none is left, including work it defers in turn.
- [`Clock.step(seconds: number, frameLength: number?)`](vendor/flux/src/Clock.luau#L378-L393): Tests only: advances a manual clock by `seconds`, in frames of at most `frameLength` seconds (default 1/60).
- [`Clock.reset()`](vendor/flux/src/Clock.luau#L398-L406): Tests only: drops every pending timer, `wait`, deferred call and manual subscriber.

## Conditional

- [Conditional](vendor/flux/src/Conditional.luau): Control flow, list mapping, and keyed selection helpers (`show`, `showKeyed`, `switch`, `presence`, `pick`, `fallback`, `forValue`, `forIndex`, `selector`).
- [`type Selector<K>`](vendor/flux/src/Conditional.luau#L403-L416)
- [`Conditional.otherwise: any`](vendor/flux/src/Conditional.luau#L571): [Read Only] Catch-all branch key for [`Flux.switch`](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/concepts/conditionals#a-catch-all-branch) maps when `source` matches no explicit key.
- [`Conditional.show<T, F>(condition: unknown, component: (value: () -> any) -> T, fallback: ((value: () -> any) -> F)?): Node<T | F>`](vendor/flux/src/Conditional.luau#L578-L582): Mounts `component` while `condition` is truthy, or `fallback` when falsy, in its own child [scope](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/concepts/scopes).
- [`Conditional.showKeyed<T, F>(condition: unknown, component: (value: () -> any) -> T, fallback: ((value: () -> any) -> F)?): Node<T | F>`](vendor/flux/src/Conditional.luau#L588-L592): Mounts `component` while `condition` is truthy (or `fallback` when falsy) and remounts in a fresh [scope](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/concepts/scopes) whenever `condition` changes identity.
- [`Conditional.switch<S>(source: S)`](vendor/flux/src/Conditional.luau#L593): Mounts the branch factory matching `source`'s current value in its own child [scope](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/concepts/scopes).
- [`Conditional.presence<T>(condition: unknown, component: (exiting: Node<boolean>, done: () -> ()) -> T): Node<T?>`](vendor/flux/src/Conditional.luau#L594): Mounts `component(exiting, done)` while `condition` is truthy and keeps it mounted while `exiting()` is `true` until `done()` is called.
- [`Conditional.pick(condition: unknown, whenTrue: any, whenFalse: any?): Node<any>`](vendor/flux/src/Conditional.luau#L595): Derives a [node](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/concepts/signals) returning `whenTrue` while `condition` is truthy and `whenFalse` otherwise.
- [`Conditional.fallback<V, D>(value: V, default: D): Node<NonNil<Graph.Unwrap<V>> | Graph.Unwrap<D>>`](vendor/flux/src/Conditional.luau#L596): Derives a [node](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/concepts/signals) returning `value` when non-`nil`, or `default` when `value` is `nil`.
- [`Conditional.forIndex<L, U>(list: L, mapFn: (index: number, item: Node<Item<L>>) -> U): Node<{ U }>`](vendor/flux/src/Conditional.luau#L597): Maps `list` by numeric index, running `mapFn(index, item)` once per slot and updating `item` in place when the value at that index changes.
- [`Conditional.forValue<L, U>(list: L, mapFn: (index: Node<number>, value: Item<L>) -> U): Node<{ U }>`](vendor/flux/src/Conditional.luau#L598): Maps `list` by item identity, running `mapFn(index, value)` once per unique value and updating `index` when an item moves.
- [`Conditional.selector<S, K>(source: S, equals: ((sourceValue: Graph.Unwrap<S>, key: K) -> boolean)?): Selector<K>`](vendor/flux/src/Conditional.luau#L599): Creates a keyed selector that tracks which key matches `source` in O(1) (or O(observed keys) with a custom `equals` comparator).
- [`Selector`](vendor/flux/src/Conditional.luau#L430): Constructors: `Conditional.selector`.
- [`Selector:get(key: any): boolean`](vendor/flux/src/Conditional.luau#L453-L477): Reactively reads whether `key` matches the selector's source.
- [`Selector:Destroy()`](vendor/flux/src/Conditional.luau#L486-L490): Destroys the selector and disposes its internal watcher and per-key nodes.

- [`Edit.Find.Parent: ParentSelector`](vendor/flux/src/Edit.luau#L253): [Read Only] Selects the target's [`Instance.Parent`](https://create.roblox.com/docs/reference/engine/classes/Instance#Parent) and applies the property table to it (`Find.Parent() { ...
- [`Edit.Find.Path: QuerySelector`](vendor/flux/src/Edit.luau#L260): [Read Only] Walks a `.`-separated child path from the target (`Parent` or `^` climbs to `Instance.Parent`) and applies the property table to the final [`Instance`](https://create.roblox.com/docs/reference/engine/classes/Instance).
- [`Edit.Find.Query: QuerySelector`](vendor/flux/src/Edit.luau#L268): [Read Only] Selects every descendant matching a Roblox query string via [`Instance:QueryDescendants`](https://create.roblox.com/docs/reference/engine/classes/Instance#QueryDescendants) and applies the property table to each match.
- [`Edit.Find.QueryFirst: QuerySelector`](vendor/flux/src/Edit.luau#L276): [Read Only] Selects the first descendant matching a Roblox query string via [`Instance:QueryDescendants`](https://create.roblox.com/docs/reference/engine/classes/Instance#QueryDescendants) and applies the property table to it.

## Graph

- [Graph](vendor/flux/src/Graph.luau): The reactive graph: signals hold values, computeds derive them lazily, effects react to them, and scopes own the reactions and cleanups created inside them.
- [`type Cleanable`](vendor/flux/src/Graph.luau#L27-L38)
- [`type Context<T>`](vendor/flux/src/Graph.luau#L2502-L2518)
- [`type Node<T = any>`](vendor/flux/src/Graph.luau#L2839-L2880): A reactive node holding a `T` (a signal, computed, effect, or scope).
- [`type State<T = any>`](vendor/flux/src/Graph.luau#L2886-L2927): A writable signal node whose `:set(value)` method is type-checked against `T`.
- [`type Reactive<T> = T | Node<T> | (() -> T)`](vendor/flux/src/Graph.luau#L2943): A plain `T`, a `Node<T>`, or a `() -> T` getter function.
- [`type function Unwrap(value: type)`](vendor/flux/src/Graph.luau#L2948-L2996): Extracts the underlying value type `T` from a `Node<T>`, getter `() -> T`, or plain `T` (distributing over unions).
- [`type Owner = { any }`](vendor/flux/src/Graph.luau#L2999)
- [`Graph.new(obj: any, isEffect: boolean?, equals: any): any`](vendor/flux/src/Graph.luau#L3007): Wraps `obj` in a reactive node: a [signal](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/concepts/signals) for a plain value, a [computed](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/concepts/computeds) for a function, or an [effect](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/concepts/effects) when `isEffect` is `true` (existing nodes pass through as-is).
- [`Graph.signal(initial: any, equals: any): any`](vendor/flux/src/Graph.luau#L3019): Creates a writable [signal](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/concepts/signals) holding `initial`, using `equals` (default `==`) to skip unchanged writes.
- [`Graph.computed(fn: any, equals: any): any`](vendor/flux/src/Graph.luau#L3032): Creates a lazily cached [computed](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/concepts/computeds) node derived from `fn`.
- [`Graph.effect(fn: (...any) -> ...any): any`](vendor/flux/src/Graph.luau#L3043): Schedules `fn` to run on the next flush and re-run whenever any node it reads changes.
- [`Graph.getter(node: any): any`](vendor/flux/src/Graph.luau#L3055): Returns a plain function that reads `node` with tracking, avoiding wrapper `__call` overhead in hot loops.
- [`Graph.setter(node: any): any`](vendor/flux/src/Graph.luau#L3059): Returns a plain function that writes `node` (`setter(value, force)`), avoiding wrapper `__call` overhead in hot loops.
- [`Graph.createSignal<T>(initial: T, equals: ((T, T: any) -> boolean)?): (() -> T, (value: T, force: boolean?) -> T)`](vendor/flux/src/Graph.luau#L3072): Creates a lightweight signal without a node wrapper and returns `(getter, setter)`.
- [`Graph.createMemo<T>(fn: () -> T, equals: ((T, T) -> boolean)?): () -> T`](vendor/flux/src/Graph.luau#L3084): Creates a lightweight computed without a node wrapper and returns its tracked getter function.
- [`Graph.createEffect(fn: (...any) -> ...any)`](vendor/flux/src/Graph.luau#L3095): Creates a lightweight effect without returning a node wrapper.
- [`Graph.flush()`](vendor/flux/src/Graph.luau#L3101): Runs all queued [effects](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/concepts/effects) immediately instead of waiting for the next frame.
- [`Graph.scope<T>(fn: (scope: Node<any>) -> T): (Node<any>, T)`](vendor/flux/src/Graph.luau#L3114): Runs `fn` in a new owner [scope](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/concepts/scopes) and returns `(scope, result)`.
- [`Graph.cleanup(obj: Cleanable)`](vendor/flux/src/Graph.luau#L3128): Registers `obj` to be disposed via [`Flux.dispose`](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/concepts/scopes#disposing-by-hand-with-flux-dispose) before the running reaction re-runs and when its owner is destroyed.
- [`Graph.dispose(obj: Cleanable?)`](vendor/flux/src/Graph.luau#L3140): Tears down `obj` immediately (functions, instances, connections, threads, objects with `Destroy`/`Disconnect` methods, or arrays of cleanables).
- [`Graph.getOwner(): Owner?`](vendor/flux/src/Graph.luau#L3147): Returns the active reactive owner, or `nil` at the root.
- [`Graph.withOwner(node: any, fn: () -> ...any): ...any`](vendor/flux/src/Graph.luau#L3155): Runs `fn` with `owner` (from `Flux.getOwner`, a node, or `nil` for unowned roots) as the active owner and restores its captured [context](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/concepts/context#deferred-code).
- [`Graph.untrack(fn: (() -> ...any)?): ...any`](vendor/flux/src/Graph.luau#L3169): Runs `fn` without dependency [tracking](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/concepts/tracking) and returns its result.
- [`Graph.retrack()`](vendor/flux/src/Graph.luau#L3181): Resumes [tracking](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/concepts/tracking) after a bare `Flux.untrack()` in the same function body.
- [`Graph.raw(object: any): any`](vendor/flux/src/Graph.luau#L3187): Reads a `Reactive` value (node, getter function, or plain value) without subscribing the running reaction.
- [`Graph.read(object: any): any`](vendor/flux/src/Graph.luau#L3199): Reads a `Reactive` value (node, getter function, or plain value) and subscribes the running reaction if it's dynamic.
- [`Graph.safe<T>(tryFn: () -> T, fallback: T | (err: unknown) -> T, equals: ((a: T, b: T) -> boolean)?): Node<T>`](vendor/flux/src/Graph.luau#L3207): Creates a [computed](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/concepts/computeds) that evaluates `tryFn` and returns `fallback` (a static value or an untracked `(err) -> T` function) if `tryFn` throws.
- [`Graph.context(default: any): any`](vendor/flux/src/Graph.luau#L3219): Creates a [context](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/concepts/context) with the given `default` value for passing data down a component tree without prop drilling.
- [`Graph.bindContext<A..., R...>(fn: (A...) -> R...): (A...) -> R...`](vendor/flux/src/Graph.luau#L3232): Wraps `fn` so every call sees the [context](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/concepts/context#deferred-code) values active when `bindContext` was called.
- [`Graph.isNode(object: any): boolean`](vendor/flux/src/Graph.luau#L3238): Returns `true` if `object` is a Flux [node](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/concepts/signals).
- [`Graph.isReactive(): boolean`](vendor/flux/src/Graph.luau#L3246): Returns `true` if called inside a tracking [computed](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/concepts/computeds) or [effect](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/concepts/effects).
- [`Node`](vendor/flux/src/Graph.luau#L2054-L2134): Constructors: `Graph.effect`, `Graph.scope`.
- [`Node:peek(): any`](vendor/flux/src/Graph.luau#L2073-L2075): Reads the node's current value without subscribing the caller.
- [`Node:get(): any`](vendor/flux/src/Graph.luau#L2082-L2084): Reads the node's current value (`node()` does the same) and subscribes the running [computed](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/concepts/computeds) or [effect](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/concepts/effects).
- [`Node:set(value: any, force: boolean?): any`](vendor/flux/src/Graph.luau#L2091-L2093): Writes `value` (`node(value)` does the same), skipping propagation when it equals the current value (`~=` or the node's `equals`).
- [`Node:update(): any`](vendor/flux/src/Graph.luau#L2099-L2102): Notifies the node's dependents without changing its value, useful after mutating a table in place.
- [`Node:Destroy()`](vendor/flux/src/Graph.luau#L2109-L2111): Disconnects the node from its sources and observers, then runs its pending [`Flux.cleanup`](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/concepts/effects#cleanup-with-flux-cleanup) values and `onDestroy` callbacks.
- [`Node:onDestroy(fn: (oldValue: any) -> ())`](vendor/flux/src/Graph.luau#L2118-L2120): Registers `fn` to run with the node's last value when the node is destroyed.
- [`Node:onObserved(fn: () -> ())`](vendor/flux/src/Graph.luau#L2125-L2127): Registers `fn` to run when the node gains its first transitive effect observer.
- [`Node:onUnobserved(fn: () -> ())`](vendor/flux/src/Graph.luau#L2131-L2133): Registers `fn` to run when the node loses its last transitive effect observer.
- [`Context`](vendor/flux/src/Graph.luau#L2525): Constructors: `Graph.context`.
- [`Context:get<T>(): T`](vendor/flux/src/Graph.luau#L2533-L2542): Returns the value from the innermost active `provide` call, or `default` if none is active.
- [`Context:provide<T, R>(value: T, fn: () -> R): R`](vendor/flux/src/Graph.luau#L2550-L2563): Runs `fn` with this context set to `value` for all code and reactive nodes created inside `fn`, then restores the previous value.

## Interact

- [Interact](vendor/flux/src/Interact.luau): Interaction state as read-only boolean nodes (`hover`, `press`, `selected`, `focused`) and the hit tests `pointIn`, `sunk` and `covered`.
- [`type HoverOptions`](vendor/flux/src/Interact.luau#L26-L29)
- [`Interact.pointIn(x: number, y: number, object: GuiObject): boolean`](vendor/flux/src/Interact.luau#L681): Whether the point `(x, y)` lies within `object`'s absolute bounds (inclusive, ignoring rotation).
- [`Interact.sunk(x: number, y: number, object: GuiObject, token: any?): boolean`](vendor/flux/src/Interact.luau#L682): Returns `true` when input at `(x, y)` would be claimed by an `Active` or input-sinking GUI rendered above `object` (or while the Roblox escape menu is open).
- [`Interact.covered(x: number, y: number, object: GuiObject, token: any?): boolean`](vendor/flux/src/Interact.luau#L683): Returns `true` when input at `(x, y)` would be claimed by an `Active` or input-sinking GUI above `object` that is not a descendant of `object`.
- [`Interact.hover(object: GuiObject, options: HoverOptions?): Graph.Node<boolean>`](vendor/flux/src/Interact.luau#L685): Returns a read-only boolean [node](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/concepts/signals) that is `true` while a pointer or touch contact is inside `object` with no input-claiming GUI above it.
- [`Interact.press(object: GuiObject): Graph.Node<boolean>`](vendor/flux/src/Interact.luau#L686): Returns a read-only boolean [node](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/concepts/signals) that is `true` while `object` is held down by pointer, touch, or gamepad/keyboard activation (`ButtonA`/`Enter`).
- [`Interact.selected(object: GuiObject): Graph.Node<boolean>`](vendor/flux/src/Interact.luau#L687): Returns a read-only boolean [node](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/concepts/signals) tracking whether `object` is currently [`GuiService.SelectedObject`](https://create.roblox.com/docs/reference/engine/classes/GuiService#SelectedObject).
- [`Interact.focused(textBox: TextBox): Graph.Node<boolean>`](vendor/flux/src/Interact.luau#L688): Returns a read-only boolean [node](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/concepts/signals) tracking whether `textBox` currently has keyboard focus.

## Layout

- [`type FlexAlign = Align | "between" | "around" | "evenly" | "stretch" | "fill" | "none"`](vendor/flux/src/Layout.luau#L46)
- [`type LineAlign = Align | "stretch" | "automatic"`](vendor/flux/src/Layout.luau#L47)
- [`type Direction = "x" | "y"`](vendor/flux/src/Layout.luau#L48)
- [`type FlexMode = "fill" | "grow" | "shrink" | "none"`](vendor/flux/src/Layout.luau#L49)
- [`type PaddingSides`](vendor/flux/src/Layout.luau#L51-L58)
- [`type ListConfig`](vendor/flux/src/Layout.luau#L60-L69)
- [`type GridConfig`](vendor/flux/src/Layout.luau#L71-L78)

- [`type CornerSides`](vendor/flux/src/Layout.luau#L90-L100)
- [`type GradientConfig`](vendor/flux/src/Layout.luau#L102-L108)

- [`Layout.padding(value: Length | PaddingSides | Graph.Node<any> | (() -> Length | Insets)): UIPadding`](vendor/flux/src/Layout.luau#L393-L418): Creates a [`UIPadding`](https://create.roblox.com/docs/reference/engine/classes/UIPadding) from a single length, a `{ top, bottom, left, right, x, y }` table, or a reactive source.
- [`Layout.corner(radius: ReactiveLength | CornerSides?): UICorner`](vendor/flux/src/Layout.luau#L425-L437): Creates a [`UICorner`](https://create.roblox.com/docs/reference/engine/classes/UICorner) from an offset pixel radius, a [`UDim`](https://create.roblox.com/docs/reference/engine/datatypes/UDim), or a per-corner `{ topLeft, topRight, bottomLeft, bottomRight, top, bottom, left, right, radius }` table.
- [`Layout.stroke(config: StrokeConfig?): UIStroke`](vendor/flux/src/Layout.luau#L444-L457): Creates a [`UIStroke`](https://create.roblox.com/docs/reference/engine/classes/UIStroke) with static or reactive `thickness`, `color`, `transparency`, `mode`, `joins`, `position`, and `offset`.
- [`Layout.aspectRatio(ratio: Reactive<number>, aspectType: Reactive<"fit" | "scale" | Enum.AspectType>?, dominantAxis: Reactive<"width" | "height" | Enum.DominantAxis>?): UIAspectRatioConstraint`](vendor/flux/src/Layout.luau#L464-L474): Creates a [`UIAspectRatioConstraint`](https://create.roblox.com/docs/reference/engine/classes/UIAspectRatioConstraint) with `ratio`, `aspectType` (`"fit"` or `"scale"`), and `dominantAxis` (`"width"` or `"height"`).
- [`Layout.list(config: ListConfig?): UIListLayout`](vendor/flux/src/Layout.luau#L481-L507): Creates a [`UIListLayout`](https://create.roblox.com/docs/reference/engine/classes/UIListLayout) with `SortOrder = LayoutOrder` and flexbox-style `gap`, `direction`, `align` (cross-axis), `justify` (main-axis), and `wraps` options.
- [`Layout.grid(config: GridConfig?): UIGridLayout`](vendor/flux/src/Layout.luau#L514-L525): Creates a [`UIGridLayout`](https://create.roblox.com/docs/reference/engine/classes/UIGridLayout) with `SortOrder = LayoutOrder` and `cell`, `gap`, `fill`, `align`, `justify`, and `maxCells` options.
- [`Layout.flex(mode: Reactive<FlexMode | Enum.UIFlexMode>?): UIFlexItem`](vendor/flux/src/Layout.luau#L532-L546): Creates a [`UIFlexItem`](https://create.roblox.com/docs/reference/engine/classes/UIFlexItem) with `mode` (`"fill"` by default, `"grow"`, `"shrink"`, or `"none"`).
- [`Layout.gradient(config: GradientConfig?): UIGradient`](vendor/flux/src/Layout.luau#L553-L562): Creates a [`UIGradient`](https://create.roblox.com/docs/reference/engine/classes/UIGradient) from single values, evenly spaced stop arrays, or sequences for `color` and `transparency`.
- [`Layout.sizeConstraint(config: SizeConstraintConfig?): UISizeConstraint`](vendor/flux/src/Layout.luau#L569-L575): Creates a [`UISizeConstraint`](https://create.roblox.com/docs/reference/engine/classes/UISizeConstraint) from `min`/`max` `Vector2` bounds or per-axis `minWidth`, `minHeight`, `maxWidth`, and `maxHeight` bounds.
- [`Layout.textSizeConstraint(config: TextSizeConstraintConfig?): UITextSizeConstraint`](vendor/flux/src/Layout.luau#L582-L588): Creates a [`UITextSizeConstraint`](https://create.roblox.com/docs/reference/engine/classes/UITextSizeConstraint) bounding text size between `min` and `max` pixels.

## Motion

- [Motion](vendor/flux/src/Motion.luau): Spring and tween animations (`spring`, `tween`) stepped once per frame, plus perceptual `Color` utilities.
- [`type Spring<T>`](vendor/flux/src/Motion.luau#L44-L53)
- [`Motion.step(dt: number?)`](vendor/flux/src/Motion.luau#L1134): Advances every active [spring](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/motion/spring) and [tween](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/motion/tween) by `dt` seconds (or the time since the last step).
- [`Motion.spring<A>(target: A, frequency: Reactive<number>?, damping: Reactive<number>?, initialVelocity: any?): Spring<Unwrap<A>>`](vendor/flux/src/Motion.luau#L1148-L1194): Creates a [node](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/concepts/signals) that animates toward `target` using an analytic harmonic oscillator (`frequency` in Hz and `damping` ratio both default to `1` and may be reactive).
- [`Motion.tween<A>(target: A, tweenInfo: Reactive<TweenInfo>?): Graph.Node<Unwrap<A>>`](vendor/flux/src/Motion.luau#L1203-L1243): Creates a [node](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/concepts/signals) that eases toward `target` over a [`TweenInfo`](https://create.roblox.com/docs/reference/engine/datatypes/TweenInfo) curve.
- [`Motion.Color.Oklab`](vendor/flux/src/Motion.luau#L207)
- [`Motion.Color.Oklab.fromLinear(color: Color3): Vector3`](vendor/flux/src/Motion.luau#L156-L158): Converts a Color3 in linear sRGB space to a Vector3 in Oklab space.
- [`Motion.Color.Oklab.toLinear(color: Vector3, clamped: boolean?): Color3`](vendor/flux/src/Motion.luau#L160-L162): Converts a Vector3 in Oklab space to a Color3 in linear sRGB space.
- [`Motion.Color.Oklab.fromRGB(rgb: Color3): Vector3`](vendor/flux/src/Motion.luau#L164-L166): Converts a Color3 in sRGB space to a Vector3 in Oklab space.
- [`Motion.Color.Oklab.toRGB(lab: Vector3, clamped: boolean?): Color3`](vendor/flux/src/Motion.luau#L168-L170): Converts a Vector3 in Oklab space to a Color3 in sRGB space.
- [`Motion.Color.Oklab.lighten(lab: Vector3, amount: number): Vector3`](vendor/flux/src/Motion.luau#L172-L174): Raises Oklab lightness by `amount` (negative darkens).
- [`Motion.Color.Oklab.saturate(lab: Vector3, amount: number): Vector3`](vendor/flux/src/Motion.luau#L176-L179): Raises Oklab chroma by `amount`, preserving hue and lightness (negative desaturates).
- [`Motion.Color.Oklab.rotateHue(lab: Vector3, degrees: number): Vector3`](vendor/flux/src/Motion.luau#L181-L184): Rotates hue by `degrees`, preserving chroma and lightness.
- [`Motion.Color.Oklab.grayscale(lab: Vector3): Vector3`](vendor/flux/src/Motion.luau#L186-L188): Removes all chroma, preserving Oklab lightness.
- [`Motion.Color.Oklab.mix(lab1: Vector3, lab2: Vector3, alpha: number): Vector3`](vendor/flux/src/Motion.luau#L190-L192): Linearly interpolates between `lab1` and `lab2` in Oklab space by `alpha`.
- [`Motion.Color.sRGB`](vendor/flux/src/Motion.luau#L208)
- [`Motion.Color.sRGB.fromLinear(color: Color3): Color3`](vendor/flux/src/Motion.luau#L67-L69): Converts linear sRGB space to sRGB space.
- [`Motion.Color.sRGB.toLinear(color: Color3): Color3`](vendor/flux/src/Motion.luau#L71-L73): Converts sRGB space to linear sRGB space.
- [`Motion.Color`](vendor/flux/src/Motion.luau#L1120)
- [`Motion.Color.lighten(c: Color3, amount: number): Color3`](vendor/flux/src/Motion.luau#L214-L217): Raises the perceptual lightness of `c` in Oklab space by `amount` (negative darkens).
- [`Motion.Color.saturate(c: Color3, amount: number): Color3`](vendor/flux/src/Motion.luau#L223-L227): Raises the chroma of `c` in Oklab space by `amount` while preserving hue and lightness (negative desaturates).
- [`Motion.Color.rotateHue(c: Color3, degrees: number): Color3`](vendor/flux/src/Motion.luau#L233-L237): Rotates the hue of `c` by `degrees` around the Oklab color wheel while preserving chroma and lightness.
- [`Motion.Color.grayscale(c: Color3): Color3`](vendor/flux/src/Motion.luau#L243-L246): Strips all chroma from `c`, returning a neutral gray with the same Oklab perceptual lightness.
- [`Motion.Color.mix(a: Color3, b: Color3, t: number): Color3`](vendor/flux/src/Motion.luau#L252-L256): Blends `a` and `b` in Oklab space by unclamped fraction `t` (`0` = `a`, `1` = `b`).
- [`Motion.Color.luminance(c: Color3): number`](vendor/flux/src/Motion.luau#L262): Returns the WCAG relative luminance of `c` from `0` (black) to `1` (white).
- [`Motion.Color.contrast(a: Color3, b: Color3): number`](vendor/flux/src/Motion.luau#L268-L270): Returns the WCAG contrast ratio between `a` and `b` from `1` (identical) to `21` (black on white).
- [`Motion.Color.readable(bg: Color3, dark: Color3?, light: Color3?): Color3`](vendor/flux/src/Motion.luau#L276-L281): Returns whichever of `dark` (default black) or `light` (default white) has the higher WCAG contrast ratio against `bg`.
- [`Spring`](vendor/flux/src/Motion.luau#L989-L997): Constructors: `Motion.spring`, `Motion.tween`.
- [`Spring:set<T>(value: T)`](vendor/flux/src/Motion.luau#L1011-L1023): Retargets the animation toward `value` from its current position (`motion(value)` does the same).
- [`Spring:impulse<T>(delta: T)`](vendor/flux/src/Motion.luau#L1030-L1035): *(Spring only)* Adds `delta` to the spring's current velocity without changing its goal.
- [`Spring:setVelocity<T>(velocity: T)`](vendor/flux/src/Motion.luau#L1042-L1047): *(Spring only)* Replaces the spring's current velocity with `velocity` without changing its goal.
- [`Spring:setCurrent<T>(value: T)`](vendor/flux/src/Motion.luau#L1054-L1063): *(Spring only)* Sets the spring's current animated value immediately without changing its target or velocity.
- [`Spring:snap<T>(value: T)`](vendor/flux/src/Motion.luau#L1070-L1076): *(Spring only)* Jumps both the target and current value of the spring to `value` and zeroes its velocity.

## Responsive

- [Responsive](vendor/flux/src/Responsive.luau): The screen and the player as shared nodes: viewport, UI scale, breakpoint, input device and accessibility settings.
- [`type ScaleMode = "min" | "width" | "height" | "max"`](vendor/flux/src/Responsive.luau#L22)
- [`type Breakpoint = "phone" | "tablet" | "desktop"`](vendor/flux/src/Responsive.luau#L23)
- [`type Platform = "console" | "mobile" | "pc" | "vr"`](vendor/flux/src/Responsive.luau#L24)
- [`type DisplaySize = "Small" | "Medium" | "Large"`](vendor/flux/src/Responsive.luau#L25)
- [`type Input = "keyboard" | "touch" | "gamepad"`](vendor/flux/src/Responsive.luau#L26)
- [`type TextSize = "Medium" | "Large" | "Larger" | "Largest"`](vendor/flux/src/Responsive.luau#L27)
- [`type Breakpoints = { phone: number, tablet: number }`](vendor/flux/src/Responsive.luau#L28)
- [`type Config`](vendor/flux/src/Responsive.luau#L30-L36)
- [`type PartialConfig`](vendor/flux/src/Responsive.luau#L38-L45)
- [`Responsive.config: Config`](vendor/flux/src/Responsive.luau#L322): [Read Only] Default responsive configuration shared by derived nodes.
- [`Responsive.platform: Graph.Node<Platform>`](vendor/flux/src/Responsive.luau#L323): [Read Only] Active device class (`"vr"`, `"console"`, `"pc"`, or `"mobile"`), updated live on the client (`"pc"` off-client).
- [`Responsive.viewport: Graph.Node<Vector2>`](vendor/flux/src/Responsive.luau#L325): [Read Only] The active camera's `ViewportSize` as a node, live on the client.
- [`Responsive.scale: Graph.Node<number>`](vendor/flux/src/Responsive.luau#L326): [Read Only] UI scale factor derived from `viewport` (`1.0` at `config.reference`).
- [`Responsive.breakpoint: Graph.Node<Breakpoint>`](vendor/flux/src/Responsive.luau#L327): [Read Only] Size class (`"phone" | "tablet" | "desktop"`) derived from `viewport` width.
- [`Responsive.displaySize: Graph.Node<DisplaySize>`](vendor/flux/src/Responsive.luau#L328): [Read Only] Physical screen size class (`"Small"`, `"Medium"`, or `"Large"`) mirroring `GuiService.ViewportDisplaySize`.
- [`Responsive.input: Graph.Node<Input>`](vendor/flux/src/Responsive.luau#L330): [Read Only] Active input mode (`"keyboard"`, `"touch"`, or `"gamepad"`) tracking `UserInputService.PreferredInput` on the client.
- [`Responsive.textSize: Graph.Node<TextSize>`](vendor/flux/src/Responsive.luau#L331): [Read Only] Player's preferred text size (`"Medium"`, `"Large"`, `"Larger"`, or `"Largest"`) from `GuiService.PreferredTextSize`.
- [`Responsive.reducedMotion: Graph.Node<boolean>`](vendor/flux/src/Responsive.luau#L332): [Read Only] Tracks `GuiService.ReducedMotionEnabled` (`true` when the player prefers reduced motion).
- [`Responsive.preferredTransparency: Graph.Node<number>`](vendor/flux/src/Responsive.luau#L333): [Read Only] Tracks `GuiService.PreferredTransparency` from `0` (opaque backgrounds) to `1` (default).
- [`Responsive.scaleOf(partial: PartialConfig?): Graph.Node<number>`](vendor/flux/src/Responsive.luau#L335): Factory escape hatch: a `scale` node with per-surface config (merged over defaults).
- [`Responsive.breakpointOf(partial: PartialConfig?): Graph.Node<Breakpoint>`](vendor/flux/src/Responsive.luau#L336): Factory escape hatch: a `breakpoint` node with per-surface thresholds.

## Store

- [Store](vendor/flux/src/Store.luau): Deep reactive stores: `Flux.store(table)` returns a proxy whose fields are tracked per key, with `Flux.Store` helpers for arrays, snapshots and teardown.
- [`Store.new<T>(initialState: T): T`](vendor/flux/src/Store.luau#L250-L257): Wraps a plain table in a deep reactive proxy that tracks each read key, nested table, and array length independently.
- [`Store.Destroy<T>(proxy: T)`](vendor/flux/src/Store.luau#L264-L266): Tears down a store and all of its nested proxies, disposing their per-key nodes via [`Flux.dispose`](https://flux.kohl.gg/api/Flux#dispose) while leaving the raw backing table intact.
- [`Store.unwrap<T>(proxy: T): T`](vendor/flux/src/Store.luau#L273-L275): Returns the raw, unproxied backing table of a store for untracked reads or serialization.
- [`Store.insert(proxy: any, posOrValue: any, value: any?)`](vendor/flux/src/Store.luau#L282-L309): Inserts `value` into a store array (appending with 2 arguments, or inserting at `posOrValue` with 3) and notifies length and index observers.
- [`Store.remove(proxy: any, pos: number?): any`](vendor/flux/src/Store.luau#L316-L344): Removes and returns the element at `pos` (defaulting to the last element) from a store array and notifies length and index observers.
- [`Store.move(proxy: any, from: number, to: number)`](vendor/flux/src/Store.luau#L351-L370): Moves the element at 1-based index `from` to `to` in a single tracked step without tearing down nested item proxies.
- [`Store.reconcile<T>(proxy: T, newData: T, key: string?): T`](vendor/flux/src/Store.luau#L561-L569): Diffs `newData` into the store `proxy` in place, firing only changed leaf nodes and reusing unchanged nested proxies.

- [`Sync.flush()`](vendor/flux/src/Sync.luau#L773)
